summary: Hyperbolic's Basic pricing tier requires no minimum deposit ($0) and gives API access to all models on its serverless OpenAI-compatible inference platform (base URL https://api.hyperbolic.xyz/v1) at 60 requests/minute with community support. The Pro tier (600 RPM, priority queue, email support) requires a >=$5 deposit; Enterprise is custom. Note the free element is the $0 barrier to start — usage itself is pay-per-token (text from $0.10/M input tokens); no free-credit grant is advertised on this page.
claim_steps: Sign up at app.hyperbolic.ai and generate an API key.
Point any OpenAI-compatible client at https://api.hyperbolic.xyz/v1 with your key.
Stay on the Basic tier: $0 minimum deposit, 60 RPM. Upgrading to Pro requires a >=$5 deposit.
